artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan landing plusValidZTime_iff_plusValidInt as a new PlusLanguage/PlusIntTransfer.lean module, with C2 axiom pinning for both the L-plus twin and its L-side mirror, two docs/theorem-index.md rows, and the full registration/inventory bookkeeping a new FormalSystem module requires.

memory_candidates.content: Adding a new file under FormalSystem/<Language>Language/ in BimodalLogic drags a fixed, non-obvious registration surface behind it, and missing any one of these is a hard gate red rather than a warning: (1) scripts/measure-refactor-partitions.py's LANGUAGE_FILE_LAYERS table needs a row (0 = syntax half, 1 = semantic half) or layer_of RAISES and check-metalogic-cycles.sh fails naming the file; (2) `lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem` must regenerate the repository-root FormalSystem.lean, which C33 asserts is byte-current and which runs build-free (so also in CI); (3) the directory aggregator <Language>Language.lean needs both the import line and a module-docstring bullet; (4) `check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory` refreshes the generated inventory blocks in that directory's README, FormalSystem/README.md and the root README.md, leaving the new row's description as a `<!-- TODO: add description -->` placeholder to hand-fill, and several of these READMEs also carry a SEPARATE hand-maintained table the generator never touches. Separately, pinning a new theorem in the C2 axiom baseline is four coordinated edits in check-module-invariants.sh (the AXIOM_BASELINE heredoc, the AX_SRC heredoc at the SAME position since comparison is exact whole-block string equality, the spelled-out row-count string in C2's pass message, and C2's header prose), and any new docs/theorem-index.md row obliges a `Paper: <anchor-or-em-dash plus reason>` line in the named declaration's own /-- --/ block or C15's second assertion fails hard.
